name: GetEmailById
description: Retrieves a single email message from a Microsoft 365 Outlook mailbox using its Message ID. Optionally includes attachment details.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Outlook Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and access mailbox data through Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: Mailbox address to retrieve the email from. Leave empty to use the authenticated user's mailbox.

fields.name: MessageId
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the email message to retrieve.

fields.name: IncludeAttachments
fields.label: Include Attachments
fields.description: If true, includes attachment details in the retrieved email.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the details of the retrieved email including subject, sender, recipients, body content, and attachments if requested.
